how.title: How it works
how.intro: No need to take our word for it. Every step of a game leaves a public trace you can check yourself.
how.step1Title: Your winnings are reserved before the roll
how.step1Text: As soon as you bet, the bank sets aside {multiplier} times your bet. If it can’t, the bet is refused: no game promises more than the bank holds.
how.step2Text: Your number leaves your browser in a sealed envelope. Nobody can open it before the roll, not the site, not the croupier.
how.step3Text: The croupier, a small bot run by the site, provides a random draw without knowing your number. The die face is computed from that draw and your envelope, then the draw is published.
how.step4Text: Your browser recomputes the die from the published draw and warns you if anything doesn’t add up. When the envelope is opened, the contract checks it really is your number before paying. If the die is never rolled, you get your bet back after 30 minutes.
how.step5Text: The bank, bets, draws and payouts are written in the contract on Gno.land, readable by anyone at any time. The game and site code is open: anyone can review it.
